rules.claim: Assign color field, main shape, companion and rhythm distinct roles; remove details and confirm the main composition still reads.
rules.exceptions: No fixed universal line count or color-area ratio.

rules.claim: Give main and companion tapered shapes independent start/end positions and widths; preserve meaningful dark/quiet gaps.
rules.exceptions: Not a requirement to use V shapes on every aircraft.

validation.source_pair: E01: measured F2A author-pair comparison, not a new livery experiment

rules.claim: Transfer hierarchy and gaps between dark-base F2A and light-base F16; choose colors from the current brief.
rules.exceptions: The reference palette is not mandatory.

rules.claim: Use verified continuous wing-body area for a main/subordinate portrait relationship; do not force a narrow single-engine spine.
rules.exceptions: Critical face/hand cannot cross an unverified gap.

rules.claim: Route each real ridge and its endpoints independently and preserve the central separation; organize complex wings around these quieter lanes.
rules.exceptions: Twin engines alone do not prove a split-ridge design is appropriate.

rules.claim: Match surface position, tangent and width at a fixed seam; treat moving surfaces as independent elements.
rules.exceptions: Atlas adjacency and equal pixel width are not physical adjacency or equal surface width.

rules.claim: Choose scale, rotation and crop by the actual pose and required anatomy; balance visual weight instead of equal rectangles.
rules.exceptions: Mirroring needs an explicit check of text, emblems and handedness.

rules.claim: Compare original head/hat/hand/prop with exported instance and carrier; classify source crop, UV crop, geometry occlusion and material loss separately.
rules.exceptions: 2D alpha retention cannot prove RGB identity or 3D visibility.

validation.helper: 9 behavior tests plus E02 synthetic-carrier diagnostic; not a real aircraft transfer
validation.actual_native_variant: Primary-agent F16 official-pose exercise A..E: selected critical pixels plus actual layer alpha checked. B/D/E technical preservation does not close visual judgement; final composition not accepted.

rules.claim: Design each readable fin face as an independent recognition panel, with source pose chosen for its shape.
rules.exceptions: Shared/mirrored fin UV may require common artwork or nondirectional symbols.

rules.scope: classifying portrait instances before seam continuation
rules.claim: Identify texture/material domain, node, upper/lower/inner/outer surface and reading direction before interpreting adjacent atlas fragments as one print. Continue anatomy only across verified adjacent pieces of the same instance.
rules.exceptions: Adjacent top and bottom prints are independent instances; identical numeric UVs in different materials do not establish shared texels.

validation.source_pair: E01: measured F2A author-pair comparison, not a new livery experiment
validation.native_probe: F2A/F16 selected archived mesh points; does not validate complete silhouette or current game version

rules.claim: Keep canard field and short tapered motif self-contained; echo color order and direction without extending a main-wing figure through the moving joint.
rules.exceptions: The sampled neutral pose does not establish continuity across motion.

rules.claim: Verify upper/lower faces, axes, mirror/shared texels and available movement states before artwork placement.
rules.exceptions: J10C, Gripen and Typhoon are not validated by this Rafale source.

rules.claim: Review main-wing critical anatomy against canard occlusion in the required views; prefer restrained canard graphics when face size or motion makes characters unreadable.
rules.exceptions: Do not ban all portraits on all canards, or call normal one-view occlusion a universal failure.

rules.claim: Scan the actual target template and exported BLK references; a visually useful reference with missing files is not a production template.
rules.exceptions: Preserve the original source ZIP and keep layout evidence separate from material validity.

rules.claim: Define visual paint goals separately from verified per-vehicle channel operations; preserve unknown channels.
rules.exceptions: Author photographs and generic N-map names cannot establish material constants.

rules.claim: Construct the outer field and its internal negative cutouts together; use the source-specific topology as a studied example, not a universal hole count.
rules.exceptions: Source observations and limited constructions only; target geometry/pose and new artwork still require their own verification.

rules.claim: Use a finite repeated unit group when it serves the panel. F15 source has six arrows per row with a cross-unit color progression; preserve shape gaps and an explicit end rather than treating repetition as inherently bad.
rules.exceptions: Source observations and limited constructions only; target geometry/pose and new artwork still require their own verification.

rules.claim: When the source shows a one-sided light backing, build that offset shape separately instead of uniformly expanding the colored strip.
rules.exceptions: Source observations and limited constructions only; target geometry/pose and new artwork still require their own verification.

rules.claim: Filter geometry by the exact texture/material domain before testing shared texels; separate per-view prints before validating seam continuation.
rules.exceptions: Source observations and limited constructions only; target geometry/pose and new artwork still require their own verification.

rules.scope: Five studied aircraft and their main visible layouts
rules.claim: Select the engine family and aerodynamic layout before composing. Conventional-tail F2A/F16 use single-axis; J10C-class single-engine canard-delta has a separate proposed whole-layout branch; twin-engine Su27, F15 and Rafale use their respective blended-body, twin-spine and two-side-corridor branches. Shared local motifs do not permit a shared whole-aircraft template.
rules.exceptions: Source-specific and local development results; each new target/artwork still needs its own profile, visual checks and relevant game evidence.

rules.claim: 采用single-canard-delta独立分支：以单一机背纵向导向统领前鸭翼短节奏、中部翼根过渡／字标区和后主翼大人物场；按三角翼后掠与姿态展开身体／衣摆，核对前鸭翼遮挡，鸭翼短形独立起止。不得照搬F16后平尾人物区或压窄阵风双发整机布局。
rules.exceptions: 当前五套获选作者原作没有单发鸭式整机。J10C真实网格、UV和鸭翼局部迁移提供结构证据；整机线条、人物比例、字标与游戏活动状态未完成验证。各机型仍需独立profile，不能把方法候选称为已学成的作者J10C整机配方。
